goal: Direct-message chat: chat icon on the profile mini window opens a resizable chat window bottom-left; 60-day history in the DB keyed by a unique chat key
summary: One-to-one chat. The profile mini window (ProfileCard) has a chat icon for anyone but yourself; it opens DirectChatWindow, docked bottom-left (z-50), resizable from the top edge, right edge and top-right corner (min 280x300, clamped to the viewport, size remembered in localStorage orbit.dmSize). One window at a time (hooks/useDm.tsx DmProvider in Providers); opening another person's chat switches it. Storage: new table direct_chats, one row per pair, PK chat_key = both user ids sorted and joined with ':' (lib/dm.ts dmKey), messages as a JSON array. Messages older than 60 days are dropped on every read/append and by the daily expire-groups cron (expireDirectChats), which also deletes chats quiet for 60 days. API: GET/POST /api/dm/[userId] (device key required for both, zod chatSchema, 400 for yourself). Live updates: POST broadcasts lobby event {type:'dm', payload:{from,to}} with no text; Providers revalidates that chat and, if the window isn't showing that person, toasts 'New message from X' with an Open action. 15s SWR poll as a safety net. Friends menu (components/friends/FriendsMenu.tsx): a Users icon right of the requests bell in the map top bar opens a dropdown of accepted friends (people in a room first, green dot), each with a message icon. Hovering a row shows their profile (bio, interests, shared ones tinted, Message button) to the left of the list. useDm.openChat bumps a focusNonce, so opening the chat that's already open never adds a window; it refocuses the composer.

decisions.what: Chats are stored in Oracle (direct_chats), not OCI Object Storage
decisions.why: User asked for the existing database with a unique key per chat; read as one DB row per pair keyed by chat_key.

decisions.what: The lobby 'dm' event carries only from/to, never the text
decisions.why: Everyone listens on the lobby channel; the recipient fetches the text with their device key.
.glass/--card are ~88% opaque, so the map sidebar text showed through the chat.

decisions.what: Messages are allowed between any two users, not only friends
decisions.why: Spec says any user's mini window has the icon.

decisions.what: Chat window has no overflow-hidden; resize handles overhang the edge by 4px
decisions.why: With overflow-hidden + rounded-2xl the rounded corner clipped the corner handle, so drags there fell through to the map and panned it (found during the demo).

decisions.what: Hover preview is a child of the popover, offset by the row's position, with pr-2 padding instead of a margin as the gap
decisions.why: Keeps the mouse inside the popup while moving from the row to the preview, so the Message button in the preview is reachable. Hidden below sm (no hover on phones; the row's message icon covers it).

verification.manual: In-memory preview (scratch worktree, no env): two test users; POST/GET /api/dm both sides share one key, 401 without identity, 400 for self and blank text. UI: chat icon on Bo's card opens the window bottom-left with history; Enter sends; message from the other side appears live over SSE; corner drag resizes (340x440 -> 408x520) and persists; with the window closed an incoming message shows a 'New message from Bo Tester' toast with Open. Not tested against Oracle or LiveKit. Demo pass (Maya/Jordan): corner-resize clipping bug found and fixed; resize works on first drag; toast Open reopens the chat with the new message. Friends menu: lists 3 friends, hover preview aligns with the row, Message in the preview opens Jordan's chat, Message again from the list keeps 1 window and focuses its composer.

next_steps: Human: apply the direct_chats table to the shared DB with `npm run db:migrate -- --upgrade` (additive, safe to re-run). Until then DM routes return 500 on the Oracle store.
Open a PR from nobell/dev to main when ready.
